subject: Request: Trial extension & credit — integration delay
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir@starlighthealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@starlighthealth.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up on integration runbook

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed. Quick heads up: our backend team hit an unexpected blocker on the auth side while wiring up the KV cache, so our integration sprint slipped by ~2 weeks. Because of that we won't be able to generate meaningful traffic against the trial before it expires.

Is there any flexibility to extend the trial window and provision a small amount of complimentary credits while we finish the integration? We want to run performance tests on a realistic workload rather than smoke tests.

Appreciate any help — we like the product and want to move fast once the infra is stable.

—Samir
Samir Khan
Director of Platform Engineering
Starlight Health
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@starlighthealth.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@starlighthealth.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up on integration runbook

Samir —

Thanks for the update and for flagging the auth/KV cache blocker. Happy to help. Two quick asks so I can get an internal approval:
1) Rough estimate of the additional time you need (days/weeks).
2) Typical peak concurrency and target seq length for your perf run (so I can size credits).

If you prefer, I can propose an extension + credits package and run it by my manager and CS.

I can also schedule a short call with our integrations engineer to unblock the auth piece if that would be helpful.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachment: trial-usage-summary.csv (sample from your sandbox session)
From: Samir Khan <samir@starlighthealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up on integration runbook

Thanks Rishi.

Answers below:
- ETA: we need an additional 3 weeks to finish the auth changes and run an end-to-end perf pass; target completion March 20.
- Traffic for perf run: ~8 concurrent clients, average request size ~900 tokens, spikes to 12 concurrent during simulated peak.

We'd appreciate an extension that covers that window and enough credits to run a couple of multi-hour perf windows plus validation runs — guessing ~$2k of consumption. If you can pair us with an eng at Redwood for the auth timeout nuance, that’d be great.

I'll also share a short test plan doc later today.

Best,
Samir
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Trial extension request from Starlight Health (SF-12345)

Hi Lauren / Neha —

Looping you in on a trial extension request from Starlight Health (deal SF-12345). Key points:
- Customer needs ~3 extra weeks (to ~2026-03-20) due to auth/KV cache integration blocker.
- They asked for ~$2k in complimentary credits to run perf windows (~8 concurrent, ~900 token average).
- They've been engaged with product eval earlier; good intent to proceed if perf checks out.

Suggested offer: 30-day extension + $2,000 credits conditioned on signed updated trial MPA and a short evaluation plan (to prevent misuse). We should also offer a quick 30-min technical pairing with one of our integrations engineers to help triage the auth timeout.

Can you confirm approval level for the credits? If approved I’ll send revised MPA and confirm next steps with Samir.

Thanks — Rishi
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trial extension request from Starlight Health (SF-12345)

Rishi —

Approve the suggested package with one modification: make the extension 28 days (round number for our billing cycles) and cap complimentary credits at $1,800 so we keep a small runway buffer. Require the signed updated trial MPA and a brief evaluation plan with dates. Also confirm that CS (Neha) will own the triage call.

If they agree to the conditions, proceed and send the updated MPA (legal already OK with the form we use). Please log the concession in HubSpot and tie it to SF-12345.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@starlighthealth.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@starlighthealth.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up on integration runbook — Trial extension approved

Samir —

Good news: we can extend your trial and provide complimentary credits. Summary of what we can do: 
- Trial window extended by 28 days, new expiry: 2026-03-24 23:59 UTC.
- $1,800 promotional credits applied to your account for perf and validation runs.
- Conditions: please sign the attached updated trial MPA (attached: updated-trial-mpa.pdf) and share a short evaluation plan (3–4 bullets + target test dates).

Neha from CS will be your technical contact and can run a 30-min triage session next week to help with the auth/KV cache behavior. Neha — can you propose 2 slots for next Tuesday/Wednesday?

Next steps for you: 1) review & sign the MPA, 2) send test plan, 3) we’ll schedule the tech pairing. Once we have the signed MPA I’ll apply the credits and confirm the new expiry.

If you’d like, I can also arrange a quick walkthrough of performance tips (batching/kv warmup) to reduce consumption during your runs.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you to a reliable perf baseline.

—Rishi

Account Executive | Redwood Inference
